title: agent.completions.message.SystemMessageExpression
description: Expression variant of [`SystemMessage`] for dynamic content.

content.description:
The message content expression.

A value that can be either a literal or an expression.

This allows Function definitions to mix static values with dynamic
expressions. During compilation, expressions are evaluated while
literal values pass through unchanged.

# Example

Literal value:
```json
"hello world"
```

JMESPath expression:
```json
{"$jmespath": "input.greeting"}
```

Starlark expression:
```json
{"$starlark": "input['greeting']"}
```

anyOf.description: An expression (JMESPath or Starlark) to evaluate.
